column1: # oracle-health baseline — per-target kill-rate floor for scripts/fuzzing/oracle-health.sh.
# This file is BOTH the run manifest (which target, package, funcs, budget) and the
# regression threshold. oracle-health.sh runs tools/oraclehealth for each row with the
# shared allowlist (tools/oraclehealth/oracle-health-allowlist.tsv), then fails if any
# target's measured kill-rate is below kill_rate - tolerance, or if a row's target is
# missing from the measurement.
# kill_rate / tolerance are percentages / percentage-points. The rates below were
# measured 2026-11-13 on branch fuzz/oracle-hardening (go 1.27.3) after the oracle
# hardening, WITH the allowlist applied (equivalent/dead survivors excluded), so every
# target is 100% of its genuine-hole denominator. tolerance 10 catches a real oracle
# weakening (a deleted assertion re-opens >=1 non-allowlisted survivor, dropping the
# rate ~13pt to <=86% on a ~7-mutant denominator) while absorbing a single incidental
# build-fail or sampling shift. Sampling is deterministic (fixed seed), so a green run
# reproduces exactly; re-measure and bump a row when its package's candidate set changes.
# Columns (tab-separated): target  package  funcs  fuzztime  max  seed  kill_rate  tolerance
